translations.web: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
translations.bsb: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.
translations.kjv: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
translations.asv: The more the prophets called them, the more they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
